# Panel

A card with a header, body, footer and optional collapse.

```tsx
import { Panel } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- Settings sections, grouped forms and any block that needs a title, actions or a footer.
- `collapsible` for secondary sections the reader may skip.

## When not to

- A plain wrapper: use Card.
- Several collapsible panels in a stack: use Accordion, which manages them as a group.

## Examples

### Header, body and footer

The title is a heading (level 3 by default). Actions sit in the header; the footer holds the buttons that save or cancel.

```tsx
<Panel
  className="max-w-xl"
  title="Recordatorios"
  description="Cuándo te avisamos antes de cada sesión"
  Icon={IconClock}
  actions={<Button variant="outline">Editar</Button>}
  footer={<><Button variant="outline">Cancelar</Button><Button>Guardar</Button></>}
>
  <p>Te escribimos un día antes y dos horas antes de cada sesión.</p>
</Panel>
```

### Collapsible

The chevron is a 44 px button with `aria-expanded`, named by the title.

```tsx
<Panel className="max-w-xl" title="Política de inscripción" iconTone="info" Icon={IconInfo} collapsible headingLevel={4}>
  <p>Puedes cancelar hasta 48 horas antes del primer encuentro.</p>
</Panel>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | The panel's name, shown as its heading. |
| `description` | `string` |  | A line under the title that says what the section controls. |
| `Icon` | `IconType` |  | A decorative icon in a tinted box. |
| `iconTone` | `PanelIconTone` | `'brand'` |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons or links at the end of the header. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` |  | Row at the bottom, aligned to the end: put the main action last. |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a 44 px button that collapses the body. |
| `defaultCollapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Starts collapsed. Only with `collapsible`. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5` | `3` | Heading level of the title, so it fits the page outline. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **The title is a real heading**, level 3 by default; set `headingLevel` to fit the page outline.
- **Collapse:** the chevron is a 44 px button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, named by the title; Enter and Space toggle it and the body is hidden from everyone when collapsed.
- The header icon is decorative; status colours of the icon box are paired with the title text.

## Content

- Title in two or three words; description says what the section controls. Put the main action last in the footer.
